work.attention.title: What needs you
work.attention.hint: Nothing here clears itself. A row acts where one press is safe and says what it does; the rest open where they are answered.
work.attention.ask.approve: Every session on ask #{{id}} is handed your yes for this act at its next start.
work.attention.ask.refuse: Every session on ask #{{id}} is handed your no at its next start, and one that asks for this act again is told not to do it.
work.attention.ask.acceptRule: It widens what agents may do: {{change}}. Sessions started from now on are handed it.
work.attention.ask.choose: Publish it to a repository workspace {{workspace}} can ask.
work.attention.unanswerableWhy: `{{repository}}` is not on this deployment's register, so no agent will ever pull this quest.
work.attention.proposalWhy: The declarations propose {{repositories}}. Nothing is published until you choose.
work.attention.proposalNobody: No repository's declarations share its words. Name the receiver.
work.attention.trustWhy: The agent ignores this folder's own permissions.allow until you trust it there, so the driver is holding what would run in it.
work.attention.rule: an agent asks to do more
work.attention.signedOut.own: Daoris's starts run on it, since no account is named.
work.attention.ask.letRun: {{account}} joins {{workspace}}'s list, so Daoris may start {{workspace}}'s work on it and spend what that account allows. In a terminal: {{command}}
work.attention.ask.letRunMachine: {{account}} joins this machine's list, which {{workspace}} runs on with every workspace that names no account of its own, so Daoris may start their work on it and spend what that account allows. In a terminal: {{command}}
